trailName: Pen y Fan and Corn Du Circular Walk, East Wales
briefing: This is a 6.9 km loop with about 440 m of climbing in total. The steepest sustained climb is 1.6 km long, gaining 280 m. The walk features a descent of 370 m and a climb of 150 m. Highlights include reaching the summit of Corn Du and Pen y Fan.

cues.title: Start
cues.text: Start of the walk. This section involves a steady climb of 1.6 km, gaining 280 m. The path crosses a stream before continuing.

cues.title: Keep right
cues.text: Keep right. The path on the left is not your route. After this, the next 340 m climbs 90 m.

cues.title: Turn left
cues.text: Turn left. The path on the right is not your route. You will reach Corn Du, a summit beside the path.

cues.title: Turn sharp right
cues.text: Turn sharp right. The path straight ahead is not your route. Pen y Fan is a summit on your left.

cues.title: Steep descent
cues.text: A descent starts here. This section is 2.3 km long and drops 370 m.

cues.title: Keep right
cues.text: Keep right. The path straight ahead and the path on the right are not your route. After this, the next 2.1 km drops 350 m.

cues.title: Keep right
cues.text: Keep right. The path straight ahead is not your route. You will cross Blaen Taf Fawr at a bridge.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Continue straight. The path on the left is not your route. After 30 m, turn right.

cues.title: Turn left
cues.text: Turn left. The road on the right is not your route.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Turn right. The path straight ahead is not your route. You will enter woodland for 480 m.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Turn right. The road on the left is not your route. The path leaves the trees and is open for 1.5 km.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Turn right. A steady climb starts here, 930 m long, gaining 150 m. A cafe is on your left.

cues.title: Keep right
cues.text: Keep right. The path straight ahead and the path on the right are not your route. After this, the next 1.2 km climbs 120 m.

cues.title: Keep right
cues.text: Keep right. The path on the left and the path on the right are not your route.

cues.title: Back at the start
cues.text: Back at the start. The walk is complete.
